segments.name: Chili's
segments.description: Owns, operates and franchises casual dining Chili's Grill & Bar restaurants serving Southwest-inspired American food to guests in the U.S. and internationally.
segments.evidence: We own, develop, operate and franchise the Chili's ® Grill & Bar ("Chili's") and Maggiano's Little Italy ® ("Maggiano's") restaurant brands.

segments.name: Maggiano's
segments.description: Owns and operates full-service Maggiano's Little Italy restaurants offering Italian American favorites, banquet spaces and delivery for everyday and special occasions.
segments.evidence: Maggiano's is a full-service, national restaurant brand offering Italian American favorites through both a la carte and Family Style dining.

revenueModel.text: Guests pay for food and beverages at Company-owned restaurants, and franchisees pay royalties, advertising, franchise and development fees based on gross sales.
revenueModel.evidence: Our Chili's international franchise agreements provide for development fees and initial franchise fee revenues in addition to subsequent royalty fee revenues based on the gross sales of each restaurant.
